description: Flood Prone Districts in Zambia is a hazard data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by GRID3. The list of flood prone districts obtained from Zambia Disaster Management and Mitigation Unit (DMMU). The government endorsed district boundary shape file was used to export a subset of districts identified as prone to flooding. Coverage: Zambia. The portal files it under the publisher GRID3. Its tags are Zambia,  ZMB,  Flood. The portal shows 2020-08-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
